args.subject: Marrow Agrisupply handover
args.body:
Hi Tobias,

Handover note for Marrow Agrisupply:

- Eastbank door-label mismatch - ticket PD-4821. The receiving-door import file labels doors E1/E2, but the store's booking sheet uses 01/02. Needs sorting before anyone reimports, or we'll create duplicates. Hollis was taking setup/support on it.
- Pine Crossing missing afternoon shift - the morning receiver said the appointment screen shows only the afternoon shift (a driver arrived at 7:10 and his trailer number went on a sticky note). Hollis was going to check the shift template and have support reproduce it with the store login. No ticket number is recorded in #central-team for this one.
- Pallet-jack icon feature request - FR-882. Marrow Agrisupply asked for custom pallet-jack icons on the Pemberline Dock yard map for their seasonal fertilizer sheds. Support routed it to the product backlog for Q2 review (per Moss's Central handoffs digest of 2 Jan 2026).

Status note: the first two items are as of the 9 Jun discussion in #central-team, and the FR-882 status is as of the 2 Jan digest. I haven't seen later updates, so please confirm current status with Hollis.
